dialogues.jp: 珍しい人から電話がかかってきた。
dialogues.en: I received a call from someone I never expected.
dialogues.text: I received a call from someone I never expected.

dialogues.jp:
最初は名乗られても、誰のことだかわからなかっ
た。
dialogues.en:
If he didn't introduce himself at first, I wouldn't have
known who he was.
dialogues.text:
If he didn't introduce himself at first, I wouldn't have
known who he was.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 『はい、月城の瀬場、でございます』
dialogues.en: "Oh, this is Seiba, servant of the Tsukishiro family."
dialogues.text: "Oh, this is Seiba, servant of the Tsukishiro family."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、瀬場さんか……」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, Seiba-san..."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, Seiba-san..."

dialogues.jp:
俺におっさんの知り合いなんていたっけと、本
気で考えてしまった。
dialogues.en:
I was thinking of all the old guys I knew, trying to place
the voice.
dialogues.text:
I was thinking of all the old guys I knew, trying to place
the voice.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
『もし、お時間がございましたら、遊びにいらっ
　しゃいませんか？』
dialogues.en: "If you are not busy, would you mind coming over?"
dialogues.text: "If you are not busy, would you mind coming over?"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「月城の家に？　彼女、少しは元気になりまし
　たか？」
dialogues.en: "To Tsukishiro's place? Has she gotten better?"
dialogues.text: "To Tsukishiro's place? Has she gotten better?"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
『体調の方は、もうすっかりよくなられました。
　しかし、やはり、まだ落ち込んでいらっしゃ
　るようです』
dialogues.en:
"The mistress's physical condition has returned to normal.
However, her mood is still one of depression."
dialogues.text:
"The mistress's physical condition has returned to normal.
However, her mood is still one of depression."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか……」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 『そこで、朝倉様に相談があるのです』
dialogues.en:
"I wish to consult Asakura-sama about a matter regarding
that."
dialogues.text:
"I wish to consult Asakura-sama about a matter regarding
that."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「俺に、相談？」
dialogues.en: "Consult, with me?"
dialogues.text: "Consult, with me?"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
『はい……。できれば、天枷様や杉並様にも来
　ていただいて……』
dialogues.en:
"Yes... if you could come with Amakase-sama, and
Suginami-sama..."
dialogues.text:
"Yes... if you could come with Amakase-sama, and
Suginami-sama..."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「美春はともかく、杉並はちょっと……」
dialogues.en: "I've no problems with Miharu, but Suginami is a little..."
dialogues.text: "I've no problems with Miharu, but Suginami is a little..."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
『いえいえ、杉並様は朝倉様が思っていらっしゃ
　るよりずっと色々お考えですよ』
dialogues.en:
"Oh, it would be no problem at all. I know Suginami-sama is
always thinking of ways to help you."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, it would be no problem at all. I know Suginami-sama is
always thinking of ways to help you."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「そうですかぁ？　俺にはそうは思えませんが」
dialogues.en: "You think so? Because I sure don't."
dialogues.text: "You think so? Because I sure don't."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 『わかるのですよ』
dialogues.en: "I understand."
dialogues.text: "I understand."

dialogues.jp:
受話器の向こうで、瀬場さんが心なしか笑って
いるような気がした。
dialogues.en: I heard him chuckling merrily on the other side.
dialogues.text: I heard him chuckling merrily on the other side.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 『あのお方とは、同じ｛・・／匂い｝がいたしますので』
dialogues.en: "We have the same kind of... shall I say, scent, after all."
dialogues.text: "We have the same kind of... shall I say, scent, after all."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「そうですか……。じゃあ、後ほどお供を連れ
　てお伺いします」
dialogues.en: "I see... in any case, I'd bring my companions over."
dialogues.text: "I see... in any case, I'd bring my companions over."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 『お願いします』
dialogues.en: "Please do."
dialogues.text: "Please do."

dialogues.jp: しばらくして、お供の連中が、うちに集まった。
dialogues.en: I quickly gathered my fellow companions.
dialogues.text: I quickly gathered my fellow companions.

dialogues.jp: 「美春……。お前なぁ、察しろよ」
dialogues.en: "Miharu... what's your opinion on this?"
dialogues.text: "Miharu... what's your opinion on this?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「え？　何をですか？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Opinion on what?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? Opinion on what?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「杉並は、無理に連れてこなくていいからなっ
　て言っただろ？」
dialogues.en: "Would it be unreasonable to not tell Suginami about this?"
dialogues.text: "Would it be unreasonable to not tell Suginami about this?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「はあ、だって、杉並先輩はすぐ掴まりました
　から」
dialogues.en: "Huh, but, isn't he coming very soon?"
dialogues.text: "Huh, but, isn't he coming very soon?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「だから、察しろっつってんだ」
dialogues.en: "That's why I'm asking you now."
dialogues.text: "That's why I'm asking you now."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「だって……、外に出たら杉並先輩が、既に待っ
　てるんですもん」
dialogues.en:
"But... he's already left his home, it's too late to reverse
it now..."
dialogues.text:
"But... he's already left his home, it's too late to reverse
it now..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「セバスチャンのお呼びとあらば、行かない訳
　にはいくまい」
dialogues.en:
"And since Sebastian has called for me, there is no reason
why I should not go."
dialogues.text:
"And since Sebastian has called for me, there is no reason
why I should not go."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……なんで、俺が美春に電話をした時点で知っ
　てるんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"...Just how did you know the time Miharu and I agreed
upon?"
dialogues.text:
"...Just how did you know the time Miharu and I agreed
upon?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、セバスチャンが待っているんだろう？
　さっさと行こう」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Sebastian is waiting for us, is he not? Let's hurry."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Sebastian is waiting for us, is he not? Let's hurry."

dialogues.jp: 杉並が、俺の肩をポンと叩いた。
dialogues.en: Suginami slapped me on the back.
dialogues.text: Suginami slapped me on the back.

dialogues.jp: そして、俺達は月城邸を訪ねた。
dialogues.en: We then headed towards the Tsukishiro Mansion.
dialogues.text: We then headed towards the Tsukishiro Mansion.

dialogues.jp:
瀬場さんは俺達を温かく迎えてくれたが、月城
本人は外出していないということだった。
dialogues.en:
As usual, Seiba-san was there to greet us warmly at the
entrance. There was neither sight nor sound of Tsukishiro
herself, though.
dialogues.text:
As usual, Seiba-san was there to greet us warmly at the
entrance. There was neither sight nor sound of Tsukishiro
herself, though.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「ようこそ、皆様」
dialogues.en: "Welcome, everyone."
dialogues.text: "Welcome, everyone."

dialogues.jp:
瀬場さんは、相変わらずにっこりと笑って、部
屋に案内してくれる。
dialogues.en:
Seiba-san, with his usual wide smile, led us to the living
room.
dialogues.text:
Seiba-san, with his usual wide smile, led us to the living
room.

dialogues.jp:
いつもおいしいお茶を淹れてくれるのだが、は
たして瀬場さん本人が淹れてるのだろうか。
dialogues.en:
He then served us some delicious tea, as always. It seems he
makes it himself.
dialogues.text:
He then served us some delicious tea, as always. It seems he
makes it himself.

dialogues.jp:
いちおう、他にも使用人がいるらしいのだが、
未だに見たことはない。
dialogues.en:
There's apparently other servants around, but the only one
I've seen has been Seiba-san.
dialogues.text:
There's apparently other servants around, but the only one
I've seen has been Seiba-san.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「それで、俺達にお願いというのは？」
dialogues.en: "So, you have a request for us?"
dialogues.text: "So, you have a request for us?"

dialogues.jp: 杉並が嬉しそうに、身を乗り出す。
dialogues.en:
Suginami was leaning forward in his seat, enjoying the
moment.
dialogues.text:
Suginami was leaning forward in his seat, enjoying the
moment.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「はい、皆様にお願いというのは、他でもあり
　ません」
dialogues.en: "Yes. I cannot call it as anything less than a request."
dialogues.text: "Yes. I cannot call it as anything less than a request."

dialogues.jp: 瀬場さんが、順番に俺達の顔を眺める。
dialogues.en:
Seiba-san looked at each of us in turn, and continued to
speak.
dialogues.text:
Seiba-san looked at each of us in turn, and continued to
speak.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「実はですね、今月の２７日が、お嬢様のお誕
　生日なのでございます」
dialogues.en:
"The mistress's birthday will be on the 27th of the current
month."
dialogues.text:
"The mistress's birthday will be on the 27th of the current
month."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「月城の、誕生日」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro's, birthday..."
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro's, birthday..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「へぇー」
dialogues.en: "He-eh..."
dialogues.text: "He-eh..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なるほど」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.jp: そういうことか。
dialogues.en: I get it now.
dialogues.text: I get it now.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「さすが皆様。お察しの通りでございます。ぜ
　ひパーティーにいらっしゃってくださいませ
　んか？」
dialogues.en:
"As expected, it would be easy to guess by now. Everyone
would attend the party, certainly?"
dialogues.text:
"As expected, it would be easy to guess by now. Everyone
would attend the party, certainly?"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「もちろん」
dialogues.en: "Definitely."
dialogues.text: "Definitely."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春は、得意のバナナクッキーを作ってきま
　すよ！」
dialogues.en: "I'd make my speciality for the party; my banana cake!"
dialogues.text: "I'd make my speciality for the party; my banana cake!"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「お嬢様も皆様に祝っていただければ、きっと
　元気になられると思うのです」
dialogues.en:
"I believe the mistress will cheer up by celebrating her
birthday with everyone."
dialogues.text:
"I believe the mistress will cheer up by celebrating her
birthday with everyone."

dialogues.jp: 瀬場さんは、苦笑気味に笑いながらそう言った。
dialogues.en: Seiba-san's smile seemed to have a tinge of sadness to it.
dialogues.text: Seiba-san's smile seemed to have a tinge of sadness to it.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ふむ、そうと決まれば、ひとつ暴れてみるか」
dialogues.en:
"Hm, since the both of you have agreed, perhaps I should be
the sole, violent doubter."
dialogues.text:
"Hm, since the both of you have agreed, perhaps I should be
the sole, violent doubter."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……そういうものじゃありませんッ！」
dialogues.en: "...There will be no such thing!"
dialogues.text: "...There will be no such thing!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ったく、お前はおとなしくしてろっての」
dialogues.en: "Sheesh, can't you just be normal for once..."
dialogues.text: "Sheesh, can't you just be normal for once..."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「きっと皆様なら、お嬢様に笑顔を取り戻して
　いただけると信じております」
dialogues.en:
"I truly believe that with the help of everyone, a smile
will return to the mistress's face."
dialogues.text:
"I truly believe that with the help of everyone, a smile
will return to the mistress's face."

dialogues.jp: 瀬場さんは、俺達に向かって深くお辞儀をした。
dialogues.en: Seiba-san bowed deeply in front of all of us.
dialogues.text: Seiba-san bowed deeply in front of all of us.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「お嬢様が初音島へいらしてから、私はお嬢様
　の笑顔らしい笑顔を見たことがありません」
dialogues.en:
"Since the mistress started residing in Hatsunejima, I have
never seen a truly happy smile from her."
dialogues.text:
"Since the mistress started residing in Hatsunejima, I have
never seen a truly happy smile from her."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「お願いです。どうかアリスお嬢様にもう一度
　笑顔を……」
dialogues.en:
"This is my request. Please, somehow let the mistress,
Alice, smile once more..."
dialogues.text:
"This is my request. Please, somehow let the mistress,
Alice, smile once more..."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「瀬場さん、俺だって月城には笑って欲しいと
　思ってる。だから、そんな頭なんて下げない
　でください」
dialogues.en:
"Seiba-san, I want to see Tsukishiro's smile as well. Please
don't lower yourself at us like that."
dialogues.text:
"Seiba-san, I want to see Tsukishiro's smile as well. Please
don't lower yourself at us like that."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「そうですよ。美春達は、別に誰かのためにこ
　こへ来てる訳じゃないんですから。ただ、月
　城さんと仲良くしたいだけなんですから」
dialogues.en:
"That's right! I didn't come here for anybody's sake. I just
want to be friends with Tsukishiro-san!"
dialogues.text:
"That's right! I didn't come here for anybody's sake. I just
want to be friends with Tsukishiro-san!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「こんな面白いネタ、放っておける訳ないじゃ
　ないか」
dialogues.en:
"With such an appetizing setup for mischief, there is no way
I would refuse."
dialogues.text:
"With such an appetizing setup for mischief, there is no way
I would refuse."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……お前は黙ってろ」
dialogues.en: "...You keep quiet."
dialogues.text: "...You keep quiet."

dialogues.jp:
せっかくいい雰囲気だったってのに、相変わら
ずろくでもないことを言うヤツだ。
dialogues.en: This idiot knows nothing whatsoever about moods.
dialogues.text: This idiot knows nothing whatsoever about moods.

dialogues.jp: 未だに杉並の真意は見えてこない。
dialogues.en: It's never easy to read his real intentions...
dialogues.text: It's never easy to read his real intentions...

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「皆様、ありがとうございます。当日は心を込
　めてお迎えさせて頂きます」
dialogues.en:
"Thank you very much, everyone. On the day, I will greet you
all with open arms."
dialogues.text:
"Thank you very much, everyone. On the day, I will greet you
all with open arms."

dialogues.jp:
瀬場さんは、ようやくいつもの瀬場さんらしい
おおらかな笑顔を見せてくれた。
dialogues.en:
Seiba-san finally showed one of the wide smiles, that made
him who he is.
dialogues.text:
Seiba-san finally showed one of the wide smiles, that made
him who he is.

dialogues.jp:
２７日は月城の誕生日か……。プレゼントはな
にをあげたら、喜んでくれるかな。
dialogues.en:
The 27th is Tsukishiro's birthday... I wonder what present
would be good for her.
dialogues.text:
The 27th is Tsukishiro's birthday... I wonder what present
would be good for her.

dialogues.jp: ◆セバスチャンのお願い◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sebastian's Request◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sebastian's Request◆

dialogues.jp:
珍しく、俺と美春と杉並は、瀬場さんに話があ
るからと、月城邸に呼ばれた。
dialogues.en:
Surprisingly, it was Seiba-san who called Miharu, Suginami
and myself to meet with him.
dialogues.text:
Surprisingly, it was Seiba-san who called Miharu, Suginami
and myself to meet with him.

dialogues.jp:
いったいどんな用事なのかと思っていると、ど
うやら、今月の２７日が月城の誕生日だから、
祝って欲しいというのだった。
dialogues.en:
We found out just what he had in mind; the 27th of this
month is Tsukishiro's birthday, and he wanted us all to
celebrate it together.
dialogues.text:
We found out just what he had in mind; the 27th of this
month is Tsukishiro's birthday, and he wanted us all to
celebrate it together.

dialogues.jp:
俺達は、それで月城が元気になるなら、と喜ん
で引き受けるのだった。
dialogues.en:
We happily accepted, hoping Tsukishiro would feel better
from it.
dialogues.text:
We happily accepted, hoping Tsukishiro would feel better
from it.

dialogues.jp:
さて、どんな誕生日パーティーになるのか、
ちょっと楽しみだ。
dialogues.en: Whatever kind of party it'd be, I'm sure it'd be fun.
dialogues.text: Whatever kind of party it'd be, I'm sure it'd be fun.
